name: DealRoom
description:
DealRoom MCP connects Claude directly to your DealRoom M&A Operating System, allowing your to securely work with your deal data from your AI tool of choice

* Analyze diligence documents from your DealRoom data room and write findings back automatically, with source citations attached. 
* Research targets in Claude and automatically create or update DealRoom records, attaching market notes, source links, and deal context
* Ask Claude to analyze your pipeline and instantly generate leadership-ready summaries, cross-deal insights, and portfolio analysis
* Create a fully configured diligence room, folder structure, and request list from a single prompt in Claude using your templates and prior deals
* Upload an inbound teaser and let Claude extract deal details, check for duplicate records, and create a deal record automatically

_published_faq.name: How do I add DealRoom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DealRoom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dealroom.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DealRoom MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DealRoom lists 38 MCP tools, including create_document_from_org_file, get_analysis_available_fields, get_analysis_details, get_dataroom_taxonomy, get_deal, get_document_content, get_room_permissions, list_deal_notes, list_deals, list_document_analyses, list_fields, and list_finding_statuses.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DealRoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DealRoom in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DealRoom requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DealRoom is developed by DealRoom. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
